pages.text: In vanilla, an item's enchantability contributes to your $(fpower).$(p)Apotheosis removes that, and instead treats enchantability as a chance to strengthen each enchantment you roll.

Each rolled enchantment has a chance, based on the item's enchantability, to gain one extra level.$(p)This can push an enchantment past its normal maximum. Such levels are marked with a star in the name.
